title: Aletheia: What Makes RLVR For Code Verifiers Tick?
abstract: arXiv:2601.12186v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-domain thinking verifiers trained via Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) are a cornerstone of modern post-training. However, their adoption in code generation has lagged behind that of execution feedback due to the prohibitive costs of the full RLVR pipeline. In this work, we ablate three primary choices along the performance-cost trade-off in RLVR: intermediate thinking traces, learning from negative samples, and on-policy training. We introduce Aletheia, a controlled, execution-grounded testbed to facilitate a decontaminated analysis of code verifier training recipes across disparate model sizes and covariate shifts across two common verifier application scenarios. Our analysis reveals that the optimal training recipe is scale-dependent: on-policy learning is the primary performance driver for small verifiers, whereas the thinking budget becomes the most vital factor at larger scales. translated_title: Aletheia：是什么让代码验证器的RLVR有效？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.12186v4 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：通过可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）训练的多领域思维验证器是现代后训练的核心。然而，由于完整RLVR流程的过高成本，它们在代码生成中的应用落后于执行反馈。在本工作中，我们对RLVR中性能-成本权衡的三个主要选择进行了消融研究：中间思维轨迹、从负样本学习和在线策略训练。我们引入了Aletheia，一个受控的、基于执行基础的测试平台，以促进在不同模型规模和两个常见验证器应用场景下的协变量偏移中对代码验证器训练方案的净化分析。我们的分析揭示，最优训练方案具有规模依赖性：对于小型验证器，在线策略学习是主要性能驱动因素，而在较大规模下，思维预算成为最关键因素。负样本。
tldr: 本研究通过Aletheia测试平台发现，RLVR训练代码验证器的最优策略随模型规模变化：小模型依赖在线学习，大模型依赖思维预算。
en_tdlr: This study, using the Aletheia testbed, reveals that the optimal RLVR training strategy for code verifiers is scale-dependent: small models rely on on-policy learning, while large models depend on thinking budget.
